# n8n_workflow (Resource)

Manages an n8n workflow via the Public API. Provide `nodes`, `connections`, and optional `settings` as JSON strings (typically from `jsonencode(...)` or an editor export).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "n8n_workflow" "example" {
  name = "example-manual-trigger"
  # Manual-trigger workflows cannot be activated; use a webhook/schedule/polling
  # trigger (or keep active=false) when you need an active workflow.
  active = false

  nodes = jsonencode([
    {
      id          = "manual"
      name        = "When clicking 'Execute workflow'"
      type        = "n8n-nodes-base.manualTrigger"
      typeVersion = 1
      position    = [0, 0]
      parameters  = {}
    }
  ])

  connections = jsonencode({})
  settings    = jsonencode({})
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connections` (String) JSON object of workflow connections.
- `name` (String) Workflow name.
- `nodes` (String) JSON array of workflow nodes.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the workflow is active. Create/update writes the document first, then activates or deactivates. Activation requires a trigger, webhook, or polling node — a manual-trigger-only workflow cannot be activated.
- `settings` (String) JSON object of workflow settings. Defaults to `{}`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `id` (String) Workflow ID assigned by n8n.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the workflow is archived.
- `trigger_count` (Number) Number of active trigger nodes reported by n8n.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.
- `version_id` (String) Current workflow version identifier from n8n.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# terraform import n8n_workflow.example <workflow-id>
terraform import n8n_workflow.example REPLACE_WITH_WORKFLOW_ID
```
